title: link-skills.sh: how a skill's state is decided
summary: How the dev helper classifies each skill in skills/ before linking it.

nodes.label: just status
nodes.detail: Runs ./link-skills.sh status, which walks every skills/*/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: Walk repo skills
nodes.detail: repo_skills() globs $REPO_SKILLS/*/SKILL.md and yields the folder name for each one.

nodes.label: absent
nodes.detail: Nothing at the target path. `just link` will create the symlink.

nodes.label: Is it a symlink?
nodes.detail: links_here() requires -L before it will resolve the destination.

nodes.label: conflict
nodes.detail: A real directory, or a skill the skills.sh CLI installed. Left untouched.

nodes.label: Resolve destination
nodes.detail: readlink, then re-anchor a relative destination against $GLOBAL before comparing.

nodes.label: Points into this repo?
nodes.detail: Compares the symlink-free absolute path against $REPO_SKILLS/*.

nodes.label: linked
nodes.detail: Ours. `just unlink` will remove it; edits to SKILL.md are already live.

nodes.label: conflict
nodes.detail: A symlink someone else made. The script only ever touches its own.
